newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Aztech up 13 pct as electronics revalued.
newsitem.headline: Aztech up 13 pct as electronics revalued.

text.p: Shares in multi-media company Aztech Systems Ltd rose 7.5 cents, or 13 percent, to Singapore $0.655 in heavy volume, dealers said.
By 0715 GMT, just over 10 million shares in Aztech had changed hands, putting it at the top of the active stocks board.
Dealers said the company's prospects had been reassessed by many analysts in the wake of a recovery in the electronics and computer industries at the end of last year.
Aztech's image had also recovered from news last November that it lost a High Court battle with rival computer firm Creative Technology over copyright, they said.
"It looks like the worst is over for the company and for the electronics sector in general," said one dealer.
He added that the high volume on Tuesday suggested there may have been a new buy recommendation on the stock.
Aztech officials were unavailable for comment.
